segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אָמַר רַבִּי זְכַרְיָה בֶּן הַקַּצָּב: הַמָּעוֹן הַזֶּה! לֹא זָזָה יָדָהּ מִתּוֹךְ יָדִי מִשָּׁעָה שֶׁנִּכְנְסוּ גּוֹיִם לִירוּשָׁלַיִם וְעַד שֶׁיָּצְאוּ. אָמְרוּ לוֹ: אֵין אָדָם מֵעִיד עַל עַצְמוֹ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Rabbi Zekharya ben HaKatzav said:» I swear by «this abode» of the Divine Presence that my wife’s «hand did not move from my hand from the time that the gentiles entered Jerusalem until they left,» and I know for a fact that she was not defiled. The Sages «said to him: A person cannot testify about himself.» The legal status of one’s wife is like his own status in this regard. Therefore, your testimony is not accepted, and your wife is forbidden to you.
